project.name: fitness-trainer-performance-dashboard
project.description: High-contrast dark athletic telemetry web app for trainers and athletes to track live biometrics, workout phases and exercise steps.

skills.name: angular-translator
skills.reason: Framework is Angular; apply Angular seed conventions.

skills.name: angular-architect
skills.reason: Architect must apply Angular structural rules.

skills.name: task-descomposition
skills.reason: Decompose plan into blackboard queue tasks.

global_requirements.layout: Single-column app shell: trainer header banner on top, routed outlet in the middle, toast host overlay at the bottom.

theme.iconography: custom icons (heart, lungs, dumbbell, chevron arrows)

regions.name: trainer-header
regions.content: elements: athlete avatar, headline 'PERSONAL TRAINER', website URL, arrow nav controls; data: trainer profile; states: loading | success; interactions: arrow navigation; a11y: nav landmark, labelled arrow buttons

regions.name: main-outlet
regions.content: elements: router outlet for /dashboard and /routines; data: none; states: loading | success; interactions: lazy route navigation; a11y: main landmark

regions.name: toast-host
regions.content: elements: stacked toast alerts; data: notification store; states: empty | visible; interactions: auto-dismiss, close; a11y: aria-live polite

core_services: Biometric Telemetry Service — ingests live heart rate (bpm), respiratory/lung capacity and training load streams shown in tiles and gauges
Toast & Notification Store — shows real-time alerts when biometrics exceed zone thresholds or exercise steps are completed
Auth & Trainer Profile Store — manages trainer/athlete session profile and avatar media shown in the header

shared_ui.name: trainer-header-banner
shared_ui.purpose: Hero header with athlete avatar, headline title, web link and quick action arrows.
shared_ui.content: elements: avatar image, 'PERSONAL TRAINER' headline, website URL link, prev/next arrow buttons; data: trainer profile; states: loading | success; interactions: arrow click navigation; a11y: aria-labels on arrows, alt text on avatar
shared_ui.a11y: Header landmark, labelled arrow buttons, high contrast text.

shared_ui.name: biometric-telemetry-tiles
shared_ui.purpose: Icon-driven status cards for heart rate, respiratory rate and weight volume.
shared_ui.content: elements: heart icon tile, lungs icon tile, dumbbell icon tile, detail labels; data: BiometricMetric; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: none; a11y: aria-label with value and unit
shared_ui.a11y: Each tile exposes value and unit via aria-label.

shared_ui.name: comparison-split-bars
shared_ui.purpose: Horizontal bars showing percentage splits (e.g. 30/70 vs 50/50) of training load.
shared_ui.content: elements: two split bars with primary/secondary segments and labels; data: TrainingRatio; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: none; a11y: role progressbar with aria-valuenow
shared_ui.a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow/min/max and text labels.

shared_ui.name: radial-gauge-indicator
shared_ui.purpose: Dual circular progress rings showing target completion percentages.
shared_ui.content: elements: two radial rings (e.g. 80% and 20%) with centered step labels; data: completion percentages; states: loading | success; interactions: none; a11y: aria-valuenow on each gauge
shared_ui.a11y: role=progressbar with aria-valuenow and aria-label per ring.

shared_ui.name: chevron-stepper-timeline
shared_ui.purpose: 4-stage horizontal arrow progress bar for workout phases.
shared_ui.content: elements: four chevron steps STEP 01..STEP 04; data: PhaseProgress; states: pending | in-progress | completed; interactions: none; a11y: aria-current on active step
shared_ui.a11y: Ordered list with aria-current=step on active phase.

shared_ui.name: exercise-step-cards
shared_ui.purpose: Stacked vertical cards with sequential workout instructions.
shared_ui.content: elements: cards titled STEP 01, STEP 02 with instructions and completion check; data: WorkoutStep; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: focus, mark complete; a11y: keyboard focusable
shared_ui.a11y: Cards are focusable (tabindex 0) with visible focus ring.

shared_ui.name: statistics-bar-widget
shared_ui.purpose: Dual-layered horizontal meter for live workout intensity output.
shared_ui.content: elements: two overlaid horizontal bar layers with labels; data: live intensity; states: loading | success; interactions: none; a11y: role meter with aria-valuenow

features.name: performance-telemetry-dashboard
features.description: Real-time athletic monitoring summary displaying trainer profile, live biometrics, comparative training split ratios, circular completion rings, workout phase progress and exercise step lists. States: loading | empty | error | success; toast alert on threshold overflow; 3-column desktop, single-column mobile.

grid.areas: "tiles tiles tiles" "bars bars gauges" "timeline timeline timeline" "cards cards cards" "stats stats stats"

regions.name: biometric-tiles
regions.content: elements: heart rate, respiratory rate, weight volume tiles; data: BiometricMetric; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: live stream updates; a11y: aria-label per tile

regions.name: comparison-bars
regions.content: elements: dual comparison split bars; data: TrainingRatio; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: reset comparative metrics; a11y: aria-valuenow on bars

regions.name: radial-gauges
regions.content: elements: dual radial progress rings; data: completion percentages; states: loading | success; interactions: none; a11y: aria-valuenow on gauges

regions.name: phase-timeline
regions.content: elements: 4-step chevron timeline STEP 01-04; data: PhaseProgress; states: loading | success; interactions: none; a11y: aria-current on active step

regions.name: exercise-cards
regions.content: elements: vertical exercise step cards; data: WorkoutStep; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: focus; a11y: keyboard focusable

regions.name: statistics-bar
regions.content: elements: dual-layered intensity meter; data: live workout intensity; states: loading | success; interactions: none; a11y: role meter with aria-valuenow

actions: Stream live heart rate and respiration updates

features.name: workout-progression-routines
features.description: Workout execution feature to view and track multi-phase training sessions (STEP 01 to STEP 04) and execute step-by-step routines. Views: list, detail, stepper; states: loading | empty | error | success; inline completion checkmarks and phase transition feedback; stacked cards on small screens.

regions.name: phase-stepper
regions.content: elements: 4-phase chevron stepper; data: PhaseProgress; states: loading | success; interactions: advance to next phase; a11y: aria-current on active phase

regions.name: step-list
regions.content: elements: keyboard focusable workout step cards with completion checkmarks; data: WorkoutStep; states: loading | empty | error | success; interactions: select, mark completed; a11y: focusable cards

regions.name: step-detail
regions.content: elements: selected step title, description, complete button; data: WorkoutStep; states: empty | success; interactions: mark step completed; a11y: labelled region

actions: Fetch workout steps by routine ID
